$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.grammar.haxe.lit. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-RESERVED-IDENT-NAME
arms.note: a declaration name (parameter, binder, type, enum constructor, structure field) takes a reserved word Haxe refuses

arms.name: M-RESERVED-VAR-NAME
arms.note: a `var` / `final` name takes every reserved word but `var` and `final` again

arms.name: M-RESERVED-FN-NAME
arms.note: a function name takes a reserved word Haxe refuses

arms.name: M-RESERVED-VERSIONED-REFUSED
arms.note: a `var` name refuses `operator` / `overload` too, and a module declaring one under a `#if` for an older Haxe skip-parses
